from math import gcd

def is_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 1
    return True

def col(a, b):      # a : b
    return (a + a) * b if b < 2 else (b + b) * a

def cross(a, b):    # a >< b
    return a * b if col(a, b) > 0 else (-a) * (-b)

def tl(a, b):       # a ~ b
    g = gcd(a, b)
    return a - b if g == 1 else g

def bang(a, b):     # a ! b
    return min(a, b) if (is_prime(a) or is_prime(b)) else max(a, b)

def hsh(a, b):      # a # b
